title: Despedidas: al coro, A cop de diapasó
description: docs/quests/coro.md § The choir room. Every ánima mission now ends with Gerard and Aitor sending the people helped to the choir: Aitor names A cop de diapasó and where it is, on the Meridiana next to home; Gerard asks them to go there whatever happens and to always remember it; they say its name back. It is why they turn up there every morning after. Each mission from the picker's 'won' part (just dev-mission <id> won). Run it with --gpu.
